description: This file defines an interface 'Payload' representing the payload component within a protocol adapter context, including methods for building, retrieving, and manipulating payload data such as path, value, status, metadata, and other properties.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: An interface representing the payload of an adaptable entity, providing methods to create, access, and modify payload properties such as path, value, status, metadata, and more.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: A static inner class defining the JSON field definitions used in Payload instances, like 'path', 'value', 'extra', 'status', 'revision', 'timestamp', 'metadata', and 'fields'.

methods.name: newBuilder(JsonPointer path)
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for Payload instances with a specified path.

methods.name: newBuilder()
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for Payload instances without an initial path.

methods.name: newBuilder(Payload payload)
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with the properties of an existing payload.

methods.name: getPath()
methods.description: Returns the path associated with this payload.

methods.name: getValue()
methods.description: Returns the optional value contained in this payload.

methods.name: getExtra()
methods.description: Returns optional extra information enriching the payload.

methods.name: getStatus()
methods.description: Returns the optional HTTP status code associated with this payload.

methods.name: getRevision()
methods.description: Returns the optional revision number of this payload.

methods.name: getTimestamp()
methods.description: Returns the optional timestamp of this payload.

methods.name: getMetadata()
methods.description: Returns the optional metadata attached to this payload.

methods.name: getFields()
methods.description: Returns an optional selector for specific fields within this payload.
